# Notice

This is a modern Fortran/FPM translation of the computational interface of the
R package `lpSolve` 5.6.23.9000, whose DESCRIPTION declares `License: LGPL-2`.
The translated source files are distributed under LGPL-2.0-only.

The original package source is retained verbatim under `original/lpSolve-main/`
for provenance.  That tree vendors lp_solve 5.5 and third-party support code;
those original files retain their own notices and terms.  The Fortran library
does not compile or link the original C sources.
